title: Neuro-inclusive Digital Citizen Science: What Does It Take?
content:
We are happy to share that our new study, Framework for Neuro-inclusive Digital Citizen Science: Results From the Neuro(Minorities)Science Collaboration, has been published in Citizen Science: Theory and Practice. This is an open access publication, meaning you do not need to register or pay to read it.

The framework was created to make digital citizen science (DCS) platforms like Zooniverse, iNaturalist, the European Citizen Science Platform, CitSci and SciStarter more accessible for neurodivergent people. It contains 91 accessibility recommendations for platform teams, research project teams and science communicators.

This publication is the result of a collaboration between 89 neurodivergent citizen scientists and allies from around the world, led by Dr Alisa Apreleva (Zooniverse Communications Lead, University of Oxford).
